research.description: A fictional fixture for a voice AI receptionist that answers missed calls and books appointments.
research.offer: A voice AI receptionist for local service businesses.
research.audience: Busy local business owners who cannot answer every call.

buyerMoments.text: A caller reaches voicemail while the team is helping an in-person customer.
The owner notices missed calls after the office closes.
The front desk is switching between patients and ringing phones.

specificClaims.text: CallDesk answers calls and can book appointments.

adAngles.moment: A caller reaches voicemail while the front desk helps a patient.
adAngles.pain: The office never sees the appointment that caller wanted.
adAngles.proof: CallDesk answers calls and can book appointments.

adAngles.moment: The missed-call list appears after closing.
adAngles.pain: Follow-up begins after the caller has moved on.

adAngles.moment: The phone rings during patient check-in.
adAngles.pain: One person cannot serve the room and the phone at once.

adAngles.moment: A new lead calls during a job.
adAngles.pain: Work in progress makes the next job easy to miss.

adAngles.moment: Lunch starts and voicemail fills up.
adAngles.pain: The team returns to a queue instead of customers.
adAngles.proof: CallDesk answers calls while staff are unavailable.

creative.headline: The appointment you never saw called first.
creative.subheadline: A missed call can disappear before the office has time to call back.
creative.selectedPain: A caller reaches voicemail while the team is helping an in-person customer.
creative.selectedProof: CallDesk answers calls and can book appointments.

scripts.title: The Voicemail
scripts.angle: A live patient makes the front desk miss the next appointment.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: The phone rang while I was checking in a patient.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: And the caller probably heard voicemail.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: What changed at your office?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: CallDesk answers the call and can book the appointment.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: Send me that before the next patient arrives.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: CallDesk. I will send the link.

scripts.title: After Closing
scripts.angle: The owner finds the missed-call list after the callers moved on.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: I found six missed calls after we closed.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: That list is always later than the customer.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: How are you handling those now?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: CallDesk answers and can book while the office is busy.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: What is the name?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: CallDesk. See how it works.

scripts.title: The Check-In Line
scripts.angle: One front desk cannot serve the room and the phone at once.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: Three patients walked in exactly when the phone started ringing.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: One desk cannot be in two places.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: So what takes the call?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: CallDesk answers incoming calls and can book appointments.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: I need the link.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: CallDesk. I will send it.

scripts.title: The Job Site
scripts.angle: Work in progress makes the next lead easy to miss.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: A new lead called while I was under the sink.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Finishing one job should not lose the next one.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: What did you put on the phone?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: CallDesk answers and can book the appointment.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: Send me the name.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: CallDesk. I will text the link.

scripts.title: The Lunch Queue
scripts.angle: Voicemail fills while the team is unavailable.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: Lunch ended with four new voicemails.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: That is not much of a break.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: What keeps your queue empty?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: CallDesk answers while the staff is unavailable.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: Where do I see it?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: CallDesk. I will send the site.

selection.reason: The front-desk conflict is specific, visual, and directly tied to the supported call-answering and booking proof.
